strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_howcreatedca_single
strings.value: <p>You can create a DCA bot by setting the following key parameters:</p> <ul> <li><b>Price steps:</b> defines the percentage difference at which safety orders will be executed. For example, if set to 1%, the bot will place safety orders at 1% price drops.</li> <li><b>Take profit (TP) target per cycle:</b> specify the percentage profit the bot should aim for in each cycle. When the bot achieves this target price, it ends the current cycle, completes the order, and starts a new cycle as specified.</li> <li><b>Initial order amount:</b> the starting investment amount for each cycle, placed by the bot to initiate the DCA strategy.</li> <li><b>Safety order amount:</b> the amount used for each safety order within a cycle. These incremental orders are placed at your configured price steps to lower the average entry price.</li> <li><b>Max safety orders:</b> determine the maximum number of safety orders the bot can place per cycle. The actual number depends on available funds.</li> </ul> <p>Other optional parameters:</p> <ul> <li><b>Amount multiplier:</b> set a multiplier to increase the size of each subsequent safety order as the price moves against the initial order. For example, a multiplier of 1.5 will make each safety order 50% larger than the previous one.</li> <li><b>Price steps multiplier:</b> adjusts the price gap between each safety order. This setting incrementally increases or decreases the gap between safety orders as the price changes. For example, with a 1% initial price step and a multiplier of 2, the safety orders will be placed at 1%, 3%, 7%, and so on (doubling the gap after each order).</li> <li><b>Stop loss (SL) price:</b> another optional setting to limit losses. If the price drops to this level, the bot will stop trading and sell all base assets at the market price.</li> </ul>

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_howcreategrid_single
strings.value: <p>You can create a spot grid bot by setting the following key parameters:</p> <ul> <li><b>Lower price:</b> the lowest price level at which the bot will operate. The bot will stop placing orders if the market price falls below this level.</li> <li><b>Upper price:</b> the highest price level at which the bot will operate. The bot will stop placing orders if the market price exceeds this level.</li> <li><b>Grid quantity:</b> this refers to the number of price levels (grids) that your selected price range is divided into. The bot will place buy and sell orders at each level. You can choose between arithmetic (evenly spaced grids) or geometric (proportionally spaced grids) distribution. Having more grids means the bot will execute smaller trades more frequently. Fewer grids result in larger trades but less frequent execution. For example, if the price range is 100-400, and you set the grid quantity to 3 with arithmetic mode, it would create three grids: 100-200, 200-300, and 300-400.</li> <li><b>Grid mode:</b></li> <ul> <li><b>Arithmetic:</b> maintains a consistent difference between each grid level (e.g., 1, 2, 3, 4).</li> <li><b>Geometric:</b> maintains a consistent ratio between each grid level (e.g., 1, 2, 4, 8).</li> </ul> <li><b>Investment amount:</b> this is the total amount of the selected currency the bot will use to place buy and sell orders across the grids. The maximum amount is usually the available balance in your trading account for the selected currency.</li> </ul> <p>Other optional parameters:</p> <ul> <li><b>Take profit (TP) price:</b> an optional price target. If the price reaches this level, the bot will stop trading and sell all base assets at the market price.</li> <li><b>Stop loss (SL) price:</b> another optional setting aiming to limit losses. If the price drops to this level, the bot will stop trading and sell all base assets at the market price.</li> <li><b>Trailing up/down:</b> this option allows the bot to automatically adjust the grid as the price moves, improving flexibility and maximizing capital utilization by adapting to market fluctuations.</li> </ul>

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_howcreaterecurring
strings.value: <p>To create a recurring buy bot, you can set its main parameters as follows:</p> <ul> <li><b>Crypto to buy and allocation:</b> one or more cryptocurrencies to buy. If you want to buy multiple cryptocurrencies, set the allocation within which your bot will make purchases.</li> <li><b>Frequency:</b> you can buy hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly. For each frequency, you can specify exact purchase time.</li> <li><b>Amount:</b> the amount your bot will spend every time it makes a purchase.</li> </ul> <p>You can also set optional parameters:</p> <ul> <li><b>Buy price range:</b> the range at which your bot will make purchases. It’ll skip purchases if crypto prices fall below the lower limit or rise above the higher limit.</li> <li><b>Bot name:</b> simply your recurring buy bot name to help you identify it.</li> </ul>

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_howcreatesmartportfolio
strings.value: <p>To create a smart portfolio bot, you can set its main parameters as follows:</p><ul><li><b>Crypto allocation:</b> cryptocurrencies and their percentages in your portfolio. You can set allocations manually, use equal distribution, or try smart distribution based on the crypto details and performance.</li><li><b>Rebalancing mode:</b><ul><li><b>Proportional:</b> rebalances your portfolio when the proportion of each crypto exceeds the threshold that you set.</li><li><b>Scheduled:</b> rebalances your portfolio on a regular basis that you set.</li></li></ul> <li><b>Amount:</b> the amount available for your bot to trade.</li></ul>

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_howdcaworks_prodesign
strings.value:
A DCA bot aims to get the best average buying price and then sell crypto for a profit. It starts with a buy order at a specific price. If the price falls, your bot fills another buy order. This cycle repeats until you reach your maximum number of orders, take profit level, or stop loss level.

If you reach your take profit level, your bot starts another cycle from the first buy order. If you reach your stop loss level, your bot stops completely and won’t start a new cycle.

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_howgridworks
strings.value:
A grid bot aims to buy crypto low and sell high to generate profit. When it starts, it spends portion of your trading amount to buy crypto depending on your trading range and the current price. It then places buy orders below the current price and sell orders above it at fixed trading levels. Intervals between these levels are called grids, and they form your entire trading range.

When crypto price reaches the next buy or sell order, it fills automatically. Your bot then places buy orders below the current price and sell orders above it once again. This way, you always buy low and sell high.

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_howmanagedca_single
strings.value: <p>From the trading bot dashboard, you can monitor and manage your spot grid bots:</p> <ul> <li><b>Stop your bot:</b> when you stop the bot, all pending orders are cancelled. You can choose to either sell any available crypto at the market price or keep it. In both cases, the funds or crypto are transferred to your trading account.</li> <li><b>View details:</b> check the bot details page to monitor performance, including active cycles and profit/loss metrics.</li> <li><b>Replicate setup:</b> recreate a bot with the same parameters.</li> </ul>

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_howmanagegrid_single
strings.value: <p>From the trading bot dashboard, you can monitor and manage your spot grid bots:</p> <ul> <li><b>Modify parameters:</b> adjust the bot's price range and grid quantity even after it’s active, allowing flexibility in response to market changes.</li> <li><b>Stop your bot:</b> when you stop the bot, all pending orders are cancelled. You can choose to either sell the crypto at the market price or keep it. In both cases, the funds or crypto are transferred to your trading account.</li> <li><b>View details:</b> check the bot details page for real-time performance insights and statistics.</li> <li><b>Replicate setup:</b> recreate a bot with the same parameters.</li> <li><b>Withdraw profits:</b> transfer grid profits earned by the bot directly to your trading account.</li> </ul>

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_howmanagerecurring
strings.value: In the list of your ongoing bots, you can view your recurring buy bots’ details, including general info, positions, open orders, and past orders. You can also pause and resume, as well as completely stop your bots manually anytime.

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_howmanagesmartportfolio
strings.value: In the list of your ongoing bots, you can view your smart portfolio bots’ details, including general info, positions, open orders, and past orders. You can also duplicate or stop your bots manually anytime.

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_howrecurringworks
strings.value: A recurring buy bot automatically buys crypto for you. You select which crypto you want to buy, then set the frequency and amount to spend at each purchase. Your bot automatically follows your schedule. Note that if you don’t have enough funds for the next purchase, your bot will pause. You can restart it anytime.

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_howsmartportfolioworks
strings.value: A smart portfolio bot relies on your preferred crypto allocations. You decide how much of each crypto you want in your portfolio, and your bot manages it. When prices change, your bot automatically buys or sells crypto to keep your preferred allocation intact.

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_risks_prodesign
strings.value:
Trading Bots are not intended to provide investment advice. Your use of Trading Bots does not give OKX discretion over your account trading activity. Trading Bots should not be considered an offer to purchase, sell, or hold digital assets. You acknowledge that using one or more Trading Bots may require you to pay fees charged by OKX for the underlying trades.

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_whatisbot_single
strings.value: <p>Trading bots are automated software programs that execute trades on your behalf based on specific parameters and rules that are configured by you.</p> <p>There are two types of trading bots offered on OKX — both come with risk that you should carefully consider before trading:</p> <ul> <li><b>Spot grid bot:</b> divides a price range into levels, buying low and selling high within this range.</li> <li><b>Dollar-cost averaging (DCA) bot:</b> buys more crypto if price falls, doubling down on each order and aiming to sell at a profit when the price rises.</li> </ul> <p>Trading bots place orders directly on the main OKX spot order books, just like manual trades made on the platform. The bot uses the parameters you've set to decide when and how to place buy and sell orders based on real-time market conditions.</p> <p>Please note that <b>it’s your responsibility to ensure all bot settings are configured correctly</b>, as incorrect inputs may result in unexpected outcomes. Trading bots don’t guarantee profits and carry inherent risks, including but not limited to the potential for losses due to market volatility and unforeseen market changes.</p>

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_whatisdcabot
strings.value: A DCA bot is a strategy that you can use to buy crypto at multiple price levels and then sell it for a profit. A DCA bot helps you get a better average buying price, because it automatically buys crypto when the price falls. It also automatically sells crypto when you reach your profit target.

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_whatisgridbot
strings.value:
A grid bot is a way to trade automatically that you can customize and launch. It places buy and sell orders based on your input, so you don’t need to trade manually. The main idea of a grid bot is to buy low and sell high automatically.

The name comes from the grids — intervals between trading levels where orders are placed.

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_whatisrecurring
strings.value: A recurring buy bot is an automated dollar-cost averaging (DCA) strategy. It automatically buys up to 20 different cryptocurrencies on a set schedule, averaging your buy price over time. DCA with a recurring buy bot mitigates market volatility and potentially helps you buy crypto at a lower cost. It also reduces market timing and emotional trading risks.

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_whatissmartportfolio
strings.value: A smart portfolio bot is a strategy that automatically manages and balances your crypto portfolio based on the preferences you set. If one crypto in your portfolio grows more than you want, your bot will sell some of it and buy more of the underperforming crypto to keep your portfolio balanced. A smart portfolio bot takes advantage of market fluctuations for potential gains. It’s a smarter and more dynamic portfolio management tool than simple holding.

strings.name: lt_bots_education_body_whenbotstops_single
strings.value: <p>A trading bot will stop operating under the following circumstances:</p> <ol> <li><b>Based on your parameter settings:</b> the bot will stop trading when it reaches specific conditions or thresholds you have configured: <ul> <li>Spot grid bot: if the price falls below the lower limit of the price range, the bot will stop placing new orders.</li> <li>DCA bot: if the number of safety orders reaches the maximum limit, the bot will not place further orders.</li> </ul> <p>You can also configure stop-loss limits and profit targets which will automatically stop the bot once those orders are executed.</p></li> <li><b>Unpredictable circumstances:</b> the bot may stop operating due to unforeseen circumstances that trigger OKX's Risk Management Stop (RMS) protocols, such as the delisting or suspension of the underlying cryptocurrency.</li> <li><b>Manual stop:</b> you can manually stop the bot at any time by selecting the Stop button on the platform.</li> </ol> <p>It is your responsibility to check on your trading bots regularly to see if any of them have stopped due to the above.</p>

strings.name: lt_trade_bots_bottomsheet_body_dcapotentialprofits_withfee
strings.value: <p>策略的收益取决于买卖次数和成交价格。每个周期最多可买入 {maxbuyAmount} 次，并在达到 {takeprofitPercent} 止盈后卖出一次。首次买入按 {takerFee} 吃单手续费计算，同一周期内的后续买入按 {makerFee} 挂单手续费计算。</p><p>在每次买入都触发的情况下，策略可在每个周期获得最高 <b>{maxProfit}</b> 的收益——即在完成 {maxbuyAmount} 次买入后，以 {takeprofitPercent} 止盈卖出。以下两种情况无法获得最高收益：</p><ul><li>价格下跌幅度不足，部分买入未触发。</li><li>市场条件不允许，策略无法全部卖出。</li></ul><p>当策略多次以 {takeprofitPercent} 止盈卖出时，总收益会随周期数增加。若买入后价格始终未回升，策略将无法卖出止盈。</p><p>交易策略不构成投资建议，欧易不会自行决定您的账户活动。适用 <a href="https://www.okx.com/zh-hans-sg/help/terms-of-service-us">条款与条件</a>。</p>

strings.name: pr_dcdbot_placeorder_dialog_desc_dcd_bot_agreement_desc
strings.value:
创建“双币存款飞轮策略” (抄底止盈策略) 即表示您了解并同意以下内容：
A. 抄底止盈策略不是保本产品，其盈亏取决于您设置的参数，包括对价格走势的预测以及标的数字资产的市场波动性。
B. 交易市场波动性较大，价格和流动性可能快速变化。您需对账户中的所有抄底止盈策略交易活动承担全部责任。剧烈的市场波动可能导致策略无法匹配合适的抄底止盈产品，从而暂时停止运行。
C. 欧易保留提前终止抄底止盈策略服务的权利。
D. 抄底止盈策略受到欧易平台的风险控制措施约束，具体详情请参阅《服务条款》。
E. 持有数字资产和使用抄底止盈策略存在高风险，价格可能剧烈波动。您应根据自身的财务状况，仔细评估使用抄底止盈策略或持有数字资产是否适合自己。

strings.value: 拆股/并股是公司调整股票数量与价格的操作。拆股将每股拆分为多股，价格等比降低；并股则将多股合并为一股，价格等比提高。两者均不改变你的持仓总价值。

strings.name: pr_discover_bottomsheet_bottomsheet_body_turnover
strings.value: 过去一个交易日内，该股票买卖双方完成交易的总金额，反映市场交易活跃度。

strings.name: pr_discover_bottomsheet_bottomsheet_body_turnoverr
strings.value: 过去一个交易日内成交股数与总流通股数的比值。数值越高，表明交易越活跃，市场参与度越高。

strings.name: pr_discover_bottomsheet_bottomsheet_body_volume
strings.value: 过去一个交易日内，该股票买卖双方完成交易的总股数。

strings.name: pr_event_bottomsheet_body_daily_airdrop
strings.value: 奖励将每日自动空投至您的 X Layer 钱包。

strings.name: pr_event_bottomsheet_body_daily_reward_formula
strings.value: 每日奖励 = 当日最低余额 × 当日 APR ÷ 365。APR 可能每日变化。

strings.name: pr_event_bottomsheet_body_hourly_snapshot_lowest
strings.value: 系统每小时记录余额，并按当日最低余额计算每日奖励。

strings.name: pr_event_bottomsheet_body_ineligible_cases
strings.value:
存在以下任一情况时，您将无法参与本活动：
1. IP 地址属于受限地区
2. 您的钱包被标记为存在风险异常
3. 若资产已在其他渠道产生同类型收益，将不重复发放奖励。

strings.name: pr_event_bottomsheet_body_join_btn_eligible
strings.value: 符合资格且位于支持地区的用户可一键参与。

strings.name: pr_event_bottomsheet_body_no_limit_scale
strings.value: 计奖余额不设上限，奖励随 USDG 余额增加。

strings.name: pr_exos_bottomsheet_alert_open_orders
strings.value: You cannot switch margin mode while you have open orders for {symbol}. You can do so once you cancel them.

strings.name: pr_exos_bottomsheet_body_example_inprogress
strings.value: Example: If a position opens at 00:00:20 UTC while 00:00:00 UTC fee assessment is in progress, the funding fee (collect or pay) still applies.

strings.name: pr_exos_bottomsheet_body_inuse_ratio_formul
strings.value: In-use ratio = Frozen margin / USDⓈ equity

strings.name: pr_exos_bottomsheet_body_leverage_formula
strings.value: Account leverage = USDⓈ value of positions ÷ USDⓈ equity

strings.name: pr_exos_bottomsheet_body_rate_pay
strings.value:
If the funding rate is positive, long position traders
pay short position traders.
If the rate is negative, short position traders pay long position traders.

strings.name: pr_exos_bottomsheet_body_settle_time
strings.value: Funding fees settle at the displayed time. assessment may take up to 1 minute.

strings.name: pr_exos_bottomsheet_body_spot_pnl_formula
strings.value: 现货收益 = (最新价格 - 成本价格) × 净买入数量

strings.name: pr_exos_bottomsheet_body_total_pnl_excl_iso
strings.value: 账户内所有全仓仓位的浮动盈亏总和 (不包括逐仓仓位)。

strings.name: pr_exos_bottomsheet_body_value_desc
strings.value: 按最新价格计算，您所持数字资产的当前现金价值。

strings.name: pr_exos_bottomsheet_bottomsheet_body_cross
strings.value: 所有仓位共用保证金，盈亏互抵，可有效降低清算风险，但清算时可能损失全部仓位

strings.name: pr_exos_bottomsheet_bottomsheet_body_inuse_unava
strings.value: 已被当前持仓和挂单占用，暂不可动用的 USDⓢ 资产。

strings.name: pr_exos_bottomsheet_bottomsheet_body_isolat
strings.value: 各仓位的保证金与盈亏单独核算，清算时仅损失当前仓位

strings.name: pr_exos_bottomsheet_bottomsheet_body_usds_value
strings.value: 账户内 USDⓢ 总资产价值，包括余额及未实现盈亏。

strings.name: pr_exos_bottomsheet_desc_est_settle_rt
strings.value: 预估结算价格会随市场行情实时更新，在结算时确定最终价格前可能发生变化。

strings.name: pr_exos_bottomsheet_desc_fok_fill_all
strings.value: 立即全部成交，否则撤销整个订单。

strings.name: pr_exos_bottomsheet_desc_gtc_active
strings.value: 订单持续有效，直至完全成交或被撤销。

strings.name: pr_exos_bottomsheet_desc_ioc_partial
strings.value: 立即成交可成交部分，并撤销剩余部分。

strings.name: pr_exos_convert_bottomsheet_desc_high_slippage_risk
strings.value: 较高的滑点会提高成交概率，但成交价可能进一步偏离市场价。

strings.name: pr_exos_futuresgrid_text_desc_pending_canceled
strings.value: 如果存在平仓挂单 (限价或止盈止损委托)，将会在全平前被撤单。

strings.name: pr_exos_info_bottomsheet_body_avail_margin
strings.value: 可用于全仓交易的保证金的 USDⓈ 价值。

strings.name: pr_exos_info_bottomsheet_body_avg_cost_formula
strings.value: 平均成本价 = (最近一次买入前的平均成本价 × 数量 + 最近一次买入价格 × 数量) / 净买入数量

strings.name: pr_exos_info_bottomsheet_body_pnl_formula
strings.value: 收益额 = (最新价 - 成本价) × 净买入数量

strings.name: pr_exos_info_bottomsheet_body_pnl_pct_formula
strings.value: 收益率 = (最新价 - 成本价) / 成本价

strings.name: pr_exos_info_bottomsheet_body_spot_hist_avgcost
strings.value: 交易收益将根据您的现货交易历史来计算，按平均成本价计算。

strings.name: pr_exos_info_bottomsheet_index_price_avg
strings.value: 指数价格是多家主流交易所的平均现货价格。

strings.name: pr_exos_info_bottomsheet_mark_price_use
strings.value: 标记价格用于计算仓位的浮动收益及清算。

strings.name: pr_exos_margin_bottomsheet_bottomsheet_body_mmr_liq_war
strings.value: 当您的维持保证金率达到 100% 或以上时，您将收到清算通知。届时，我们会减少您的仓位以减低您的风险。

strings.name: pr_exos_margin_bottomsheet_bottomsheet_body_mmr_reduce
strings.value: 请追加保证金或减少仓位，以降低风险等级。

strings.name: pr_exos_margin_info_bottomsheet_body_adj_eq_formula
strings.value: Adjusted equity = Sum of (Crypto equity × USD price × Discount rate) − losses from spot and spot margin trades − estimated trading fees for all cross-margin open orders (including spot) − frozen margin for isolated-margin open orders − estimated trading fees for all isolated-margin open orders.

strings.name: pr_exos_margin_info_bottomsheet_body_mm_formula
strings.value: Maintenance margin (MM) = Sum of (Maintenance margin for each asset’s open positions in cross-margin mode × Crypto price).

strings.name: pr_exos_margin_info_bottomsheet_body_mmr_desc
strings.value: 维持保证金率 (MMR) 用于衡量您全仓保证金账户的风险水平。维持保证金率 =（维持保证金 + 清算手续费）/ 权益。

strings.name: pr_exos_margin_info_bottomsheet_body_mmr_formula
strings.value: MMR = Adjusted equity / (Maintenance margin + Transaction fee for reducing your position).

strings.name: pr_exos_overview_bottomsheet_body_equity
strings.value: 链上账户总权益，包括现货、兑换资产及永续合约未实现盈亏。

strings.name: pr_exos_perp_bottomsheet_body_delist_time_date
strings.value: This perpetual contract will be delisted at {time} UTC on {date}.

strings.name: pr_exos_perp_bottomsheet_body_settle_cancel_notice
strings.value: 合约下线后，交易将停止。随后，我们将按结算价格结算您的未平仓仓位，并撤销所有未成交订单。请在倒计时结束前平仓或调整仓位。

strings.name: pr_exos_perpetual_bottomsheet_body_fee_calc
strings.value:
The funding fee is charged or paid out every 8 hours.
The funding rate is calculated using the premium per
minute over the last 8 hours.

strings.name: pr_exos_placeorder_bottomsheet_body_balance_low
strings.value: 您的链上账户余额低于下单金额，请添加资金后再下单。

strings.name: pr_exos_positon_text_def_both
strings.value: 一个交易品种可同时持有多和空两个方向的仓位。

strings.name: pr_exos_rules_column_desc_highest_price_sell_bottom
strings.value: Lowest price of sell order = Max [Min (Index, Index × (1 – {y2}%) + Average premium in last 1 mins), Index × (1 – {z2}%)]

strings.name: pr_exos_settings_bottomsheet_body_btn_count
strings.value: You can display 2 or 3 buttons for your futures positions.

strings.name: pr_exos_tradeinfo_tutorials_bottomsheet_body_actual_fill
strings.value: The amount and price that your order is filled at depends on the actual transaction.

strings.name: pr_exos_tradeinfo_tutorials_bottomsheet_body_fill_around
strings.value: If the market price is {num}, a buy or sell order is filled at around {num}.
